# Submitted evidence

Run baselines and the preserved legacy inventory.

## submission_baselines

THIS IS ONE PROJECT'S ARCHIVE, so it carries no `submission_baselines` rows AT ALL.
A run baseline is a position in the installation-wide revisions ledger; it is preserved with the whole installation rather than rebound to a project-only ledger, so there is no project whose archive these would be. The database
this was taken from holds 2 of them and they are in NO project's archive; the whole-installation
export is the one that carries them.

SO THIS PAGE IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT THERE IS NOTHING TO FIND. It is evidence that you are holding the
wrong archive to find out.
## legacy_unsealed_runs

THIS IS ONE PROJECT'S ARCHIVE, so it carries no `legacy_unsealed_runs` rows AT ALL.
The activation inventory records historical unsealed runs across the installation; a project-only archive does not claim to reproduce that installation-wide inventory, so there is no project whose archive these would be. The database
this was taken from holds 1 of them and they are in NO project's archive; the whole-installation
export is the one that carries them.

SO THIS PAGE IS NOT EVIDENCE THAT THERE IS NOTHING TO FIND. It is evidence that you are holding the
wrong archive to find out.
